<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Demo;

enum Dir: string { case North = 'N'; case East = 'E'; }

final readonly class Point { public function __construct(public int $x = 0, public int $y = 0) {} }

interface Shape { public function area(): float; }

class Robot implements Shape {
    private array $log = [];
    public function __construct(private Point $pos = new Point(), private Dir $dir = Dir::North) {}
    public function area(): float { return 0.0; }
    public function move(string ...$cmds): static {
        foreach ($cmds as $c) { $this->log[] = match ($c) { 'A' => 'adv', 'L', 'R' => 'turn', default => throw new \InvalidArgumentException($c) }; }
        return $this;
    }
}

$f = fn(int $x): int => $x * 2;
$r = (new Robot())->move('A', 'L');
echo $f(2), $r?->area() ?? 0, PHP_EOL;
